original_target.title: Optimal cubature error with small mixed smoothness

scope_comparison: The target is the unrestricted deterministic signed-weight minimax lower bound for supported F^s_{p,theta},d>=3,1<theta<p,1/p<s<1/theta. Source Theorem1.2 gives an upper bound and Remark7.4 leaves a matching lower bound. The October quantum Besov result has another function space and information model; periodic Hilbert log-critical spectral-weight bounds differ from p>theta.
